trial_court_ruling: Overruled the defendant's section 231.7 objection to the prosecution's peremptory challenge of a Hispanic prospective juror.

summary: Wrote the opinion holding the trial court erred in overruling a section 231.7 objection because neither of the prosecution's stated reasons for striking a Hispanic prospective juror was supported by the record; reversed for a new trial. verification_notes: Verified: Motoike wrote, Gooding concurred; Delaney concurred and dissented.
